items.title: Sonny Rollins — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: my heroes, like Gene Ammons, these guys, I mean, they told a great story

ctx.x: But yeah, I’m trying to tell stories. I mean, some of the guys that I...uh, my heroes, like Gene Ammons, these guys, I mean, they told a great story, and they were, you know. So, I, I’ve heard these people. So, that’s why I’m hard on myself. I’ve heard people. I know what can be done in our music, see. So, until I’m doing it myself, I’m hard on myself, of course.

Especially in your younger years–you can still play fast, you can play whatever you want, as far as I’m concerned–but in your younger years you could play blindingly fast. And I’m wondering, as a musician or as a horn player, how do you relax when you’re playing very fast tempos?
